key_points_correct: Correctly explains all three drift sources and state locking dangers
Pipeline includes validate, plan, approval, apply stages
Scheduled drift detection, OPA Gatekeeper, Helmfile, RBAC
key_points_missing: Pipeline plan stage has when: manual which means plan must be manually triggered -- unusual for CI
Plan comment posting is just an echo, no actual MR API integration
DynamoDB backend config uses comma-separated string instead of separate -backend-config flags
brief_justification: Drift analysis is good. Pipeline has structural issues: the plan stage requires manual triggering which defeats the purpose of CI automation. The backend config syntax is incorrect.
